description.desc: Despite how annoyed and frustrated Flint can be when it comes to Tasslehoff, the two are inseparable. If Tasslehoff qualifies for an adventure restriction based on his tags, age, ability scores, etc., Flint may be used as well.
尽管弗林特在塔斯勒霍夫身上常常感到恼火和沮丧，但两人却形影不离。如果塔斯勒霍夫因其标签、年龄、能力值等因素而符合某项冒险限制条件，弗林特也可能受到同样的限制。

Flint gains a Forged Bonds stack for each Champion adjacent to him. Flint buffs all Champions in his column and the column behind him by $amount% for each Forged Bonds stack, stacking multiplicatively.
弗林特每有一个相邻的英雄，便获得一层“锻造羁绊”效果。弗林特会根据“锻造羁绊”的层数，为自己所在列及后一列的所有英雄提供$amount%的加成，各层效果按乘法叠加。

tipText.original: Flint buffs everyone in his column and the column behind him based on the number of Champions adjacent to him.
tipText.display: 弗林特会根据其相邻的“冠军”数量，为其所在纵列及后方纵列的所有单位提供强化效果。

description.desc: Flint reduces the damage taken by all Champions by $(amount)% for each Forged Bonds stack he currently has, stacking additively and capping at $(max_resistance_for_description)%.
弗林特当前拥有的每层“锻造羁绊”效果，都会使所有英雄所受伤害降低 $(amount)%，该效果可叠加，且上限为 $(max_resistance_for_description)%。
Increase the effect of Flint's Forged Bonds by $amount% for each Champion in the formation who is 40 years old or younger, stacking multiplicatively.
对于阵型中每位40岁及以下的英雄，弗林特的“锻造羁绊”效果提升$amount%（效果按乘法叠加）。

specializationDescription.original: Flint thinks of his younger allies as children who need protection and guidance.
specializationDescription.display: 弗林特把他的年轻盟友们看作是需要保护和引导的孩子。

description.desc: Increase the effect of Flint's Forged Bonds by $amount% for each Heroes of the Lance Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively.
对于阵型中的每位“长枪英雄”冠军，将弗林特的“锻造羁绊”效果提升$amount%（该效果按乘法叠加）。

specializationDescription.original: Flint knows that in the most dire circumstances, he can always count on his old companions.
specializationDescription.display: 弗林特知道，即使在最危急的时刻，他也能始终依靠那些老伙伴。

description.desc: Increase the effect of Flint's Forged Bonds by $amount% for each dwarf in the formation, stacking multiplicatively.
对于队形中的每名矮人，将弗林特的“锻造羁绊”效果提高$amount%（效果按乘法叠加）。

specializationDescription.original: Flint is a dwarf among dwarves, inspiring his fellow dwarves to embrace their heritage and fight as one.
specializationDescription.display: 弗林特在矮人中堪称侏儒，他激励着族人拥抱自己的传统，团结一致地战斗。

description.pre: The effect of Forged Bonds is increased by $amount% for each completed area in the current adventure that was Underground.

conditions.desc: ^^This adventure is underground in $(flint_stonecunning_percent)% of areas.

description.pre: 当前冒险中每完成一个“地下”区域，“锻造羁绊”的效果将增加$amount%。（注：$amount% 表示具体数值，根据原文格式保留为百分比符号）

conditions.desc: ^^在 $(flint_stonecunning_percent)% 的区域中，这场冒险发生在地下。

tipText.original: Flint increases his buff based on the number of Underground areas the formation has completed in the current adventure.
tipText.display: 弗林特会根据该阵型在当前冒险中已通关的地下区域数量来提升自己的增益效果。

conditions.desc: Until he takes damage in an area, Flint gains $stacks_per_hit Initiative stacks whenever he attacks an enemy. Once he has taken damage, Flint gains Follow-Through stacks when he attacks instead. The damage of Forged Bonds is increased by $(not_buffed amount___3)% for each Follow-Through stack he has, stacking multiplicatively. The number of Follow-Through stacks can not exceed the number of Initiative stacks he has gained, and Initiative caps at $max_stacks___2 stacks. Both stacks reset when changing areas or when Flint is moved in the formation or removed from it.

Until he takes damage in an area, Flint gains an Initiative stack whenever he attacks an enemy. Once he has taken damage, Flint gains Follow-Through stacks when he attacks instead. The damage of Forged Bonds is increased by $(not_buffed amount___3)% for each Follow-Through stack he has, stacking multiplicatively. The number of Follow-Through stacks can not exceed the number of Initiative stacks he has gained, and Initiative caps at $max_stacks___2 stacks. Both stacks reset when changing areas or when Flint is moved in the formation or removed from it.

在某区域内未受到伤害之前，弗林特每次攻击敌人时都会获得 $stacks_per_hit 点先攻层数。一旦受到伤害，弗林特攻击时将转为获得“后续打击”层数。 每拥有一个“后续攻击”层数，“锻造的纽带”的伤害将增加 $(not_buffed amount___3)%，且层数效果呈乘法叠加。 “后劲”层数不得超过其获得的“先攻”层数，且“先攻”层数上限为 $max_stacks___2 层。“先攻”和“后劲”层数在切换区域、弗林特在阵型中被移动或移出阵型时均会重置。

在某区域内未受到伤害时，弗林特每次攻击敌人都会获得一个“先攻”层数。一旦受到伤害，弗林特攻击敌人时将转为获得“后续攻击”层数。他拥有的每个“后续攻击”层数都会使“锻造的纽带”的伤害提高 $(not_buffed amount___3)%，且层数效果呈乘法叠加。 “后劲”层数不得超过其获得的“先攻”层数，且“先攻”层数上限为 $max_stacks___2 层。“先攻”和“后劲”层数在切换区域、弗林特在阵型中被移动或移出阵型时均会重置。

description.desc: Flint gains the Gold role and the party's Gold Find is increased proportionally based upon the max health of enemies in the current area. For each order of magnitude of max health the enemies have, the party's Gold Find is increased by $amount%, stacking multiplicatively.
弗林特获得“黄金”角色，队伍的“发现金币”数值将根据当前区域内敌人的最大生命值按比例提升。敌人的最大生命值每增加一个数量级，队伍的“发现金币”数值便增加$amount%（该效果呈乘法叠加）。

specializationDescription.original: Flint is a renowned master craftsman, and knows how to ply his trade wherever he goes.
specializationDescription.display: 弗林特是一位享誉盛名的工艺大师，无论走到哪里，他都深谙如何施展自己的手艺。

description.desc: Flint gains the Breaker role. Attacks from Champions who are affected by Flint's Forged Bonds ability (including himself) remove an extra segment from enemies with segmented, armored, or critical health.

effect_keys.override_key_desc: $(target)'s attacks removes an extra segment from enemies with segmented, armored, or critical health.

description.desc: 弗林特获得“破坏者”角色。受弗林特“锻造羁绊”能力影响的冠军（包括他本人）所发动的攻击，会对生命值处于分段、护甲或危急状态的敌人额外移除一个生命段。

effect_keys.override_key_desc: $(target)$的攻击会从处于分段、护甲或危急生命值状态的敌人身上额外移除一个分段。

specializationDescription.original: Flint's profound skill for making things lends him an equally impressive talent for taking things apart.
specializationDescription.display: 弗林特在制作物品方面拥有深厚的造诣，这也使他具备了同样令人印象深刻的拆解能力。

description.desc: Flint gains the DPS role and increases his own damage by $amount% for each Forged Bonds stack he has, stacking multiplicatively. His base attack also gains a small cleave.
弗林特获得DPS角色，并根据其拥有的“锻造羁绊”层数，每层提升自身伤害$amount%（各层效果乘法叠加）。其基础攻击还将获得微弱的范围伤害效果。

specializationDescription.original: Flint does not waste words nor time when a battle is imminent.
specializationDescription.display: 当战斗一触即发时，弗林特既不浪费言语，也不浪费时间。

description.original: Listen, lad. I want you to have my helm.
description.display: 听着，小伙子。我想把我的头盔留给你。

description.original: I led them here. This is my responsibility. I'm the eldest. I'll get them out.
description.display: 是我带他们来的。这是我的责任。我是老大。我会把他们救出去的。

description.original: He'll be fine. ~Fizban
description.display: 他会没事的。~Fizban

description.original: He'll be all right. ~Tas
description.display: 他会没事的。~Tas

description.original: That was great! Hit him again! ~Tas
description.display: 太棒了！再打他一下！~Tas

description.original: Is it too much to ask that I be allowed to die in peace?
description.display: 让我安详地死去，这要求过分吗？

description.original: The dragonarmies... Our fight is not ended. Go find Flint. ~Laurana
description.display: 龙军……我们的战斗尚未结束。去找到弗林特吧。~劳拉娜

description.original: It was a sacred oath we took, to meet again after five years had passed.
description.display: 我们曾立下神圣的誓言，五年后定要重逢。

description.original: He is patient. He knows you have much yet to do. He will wait. ~Fizban
description.display: 他很耐心。他知道你还有很多事情要做。他会等你的。~菲兹班

effects.description: Flint's Forged Bonds ability gains three extra stacks if Tasslehoff is in the formation.

description.original: Because I need you, grumbling old dwarf. ~Tanis
description.display: 因为我需要你，爱嘀咕的老矮人。~塔尼斯

effects.description: Flint's Forged Bonds ability gains one extra stack.

description.original: Where is that rattle-brained kender? Gone? You let him go? With that old man?
description.display: 那个糊涂的肯德尔人去哪儿了？走了？你放他走了？还跟那个老头一起？

effects.description: Flint's Forged Bonds ability gains two extra stacks.

description.original: Stubborn as a dwarf, so the old saying goes. ~Caramon
description.display: 俗话说，倔强得像个矮人。~卡拉蒙

effects.description: Adjacent Dwarves grant an additional stack for Flint's Forged Bonds ability.

description.original: We're always last! Hurry up! ~Tas
description.display: 我们总是最后一个！快点啊！~Tas

description.original: Flint, you lead. ~Tanis
description.display: 弗林特，你带头。~塔尼斯

description.original: I almost lost him, Tanis.
description.display: 塔尼斯，我差点就失去他了。

effects.description: Increases the Initiative and Follow Through stacks gained when Flint attacks to 2.

description.original: I'm getting too old for this, Tanis.
description.display: 塔尼斯，我这把年纪已经不适合干这种事了。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Flint's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: Of all the hatreds, the ones between families are the cruelest.
description.display: 在所有的仇恨中，家族之间的仇恨最为残酷。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Flint's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: Humpf.
description.display: 哼。

description.original: Well, if anything does attack us tonight, I hope it's edible!
description.display: 哎，如果今晚真有什么东西来袭击我们，我希望那东西至少能吃！

description.original: Ah, now this is craftsmanship.
description.display: 啊，这才叫工艺啊。

description.original: Do you see the red star that shines above us? ~Fizban
description.display: 你看到头顶上那颗闪闪发光的红星了吗？~菲兹班

description.original: Besides, that dagger was Flint's! ~Tas
description.display: 再说，那把匕首是弗林特的！~Tas

description.original: Goblins! In Solace! This new Theocrat has much to answer for!
description.display: 哥布林！竟然出现在索拉斯！这个新上任的神权统治者必须为此承担责任！

description.original: Are we going to stand here all night, or are we going to get some dinner?
description.display: 我们是要在这里站一整晚，还是去吃点晚饭？

description.original: I still have some of the wonderful toys you made me. ~Laurana
description.display: 我至今还保留着你给我做的那些精美的玩具。~劳拉娜

description.original: You've learned no manners in five years. No respect for my age or my station.
description.display: 这五年里，你一点礼貌都没学到。既不尊重我的年龄，也不尊重我的身份地位。

description.original: Hoisting me around like a sack of potatoes. I hope no one who knows us saw us.
description.display: 像扛一袋土豆似的把我扛来扛去。希望没被认识我们的人看到。

description.original: I'd follow them into a dragon's den, if it would warm my toes!
description.display: 只要能让我的脚趾暖和起来，我哪怕跟着他们钻进龙穴也行！

description.original: You're like a solid rock that I can set my back against. ~Tanis
description.display: 你就像一块坚实的岩石，让我可以靠着它。~塔尼斯

description.original: It's going to rain again. I should have stayed in Solace.
description.display: 又要下雨了。我真该留在索拉斯的。

description.original: I remember those draconian things coming at me and falling into the water...
description.display: 我记得那些凶猛的怪物朝我扑来，然后掉进了水里……

description.original: Your helm's at the bottom of the swamp. Do you want to go in after it? ~Tas
description.display: 你的头盔在沼泽底。你想进去找吗？~Tas

description.original: It's not horsehair! It's hair from the mane of a griffon.
description.display: 这不是马毛！这是格里芬鬃毛上的毛发。

description.original: Pardon me, Respected Sire, may I be of assistance? ~Khirsah
description.display: 打扰了，尊敬的陛下，我能帮上什么忙吗？~基尔萨

effects.description: Increases the effect of Flint's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: First, Sir Flint, you must put on the padded vest. ~Khirsah
description.display: 首先，弗林特爵士，您必须穿上那件护甲背心。~基尔萨

effects.description: Increases the effect of Flint's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: Sir Flint isn't accustomed to this newer model, Squire Burrfoot. ~Khirsah
description.display: 弗林特爵士还不习惯这款新型号，伯尔福特侍从。~基尔萨

effects.description: Increases the effect of Flint's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: Now it is your turn, dwarf! Set the lance! ~Khirsah
description.display: 现在轮到你了，矮人！架好长枪！~基尔萨

effects.description: Increases the effect of Flint's first set of Specializations by $(amount)%

description.original: I should never have left. And I'll be damned if I'm ever leaving again!
description.display: 我当初就不该离开的。而且，我发誓，我绝不会再离开了！

description.original: After one hundred and forty-eight years, I ought to have learned!
description.display: 经过一百四十八年，我本该学乖了才对！

description.original: Flint Fireforge carries the wine. ~Tanis
description.display: 弗林特·火锻负责运送葡萄酒。~塔尼斯

description.original: The greatest gift! Just think, Flint! ~Tas
description.display: 最棒的礼物！想想看吧，弗林特！~塔斯

effects.description: Increases the damage of all Champions by $amount%
Increases the damage of all Champions by $(amount)% for each Male Champion in the formation
Increases the damage of all Champions by $(amount)% for each Dwarf Champion in the formation
Increases the damage of all Champions by $(amount)% for each Champion with a STR score of 11 or higher in the formation
Increases the damage of all Champions by $(amount)% for each Champion in the formation with a GOOD alignment
Increases the damage of all Magic Champions by $(amount)%

backstory.original: Flint Fireforge is many things - a fearless warrior, a renowned craftsman, and a loyal friend to the bitter end. He is the gruff and grumbling fatherly figure among his group of companions, fiercely protective of them despite seeming to be constantly frustrated by their choices (some more so than others). He is swift to act when danger appears, leading the charge with fury and reckless abandon against the evil forces of Takhisis.
backstory.display: 弗林特·火锻身兼多重身份——他既是无畏的战士，也是闻名遐迩的工匠，更是至死不渝的忠实朋友。 在同伴们眼中，他是那位粗犷又爱嘀咕的父亲般的人物，尽管看似总是对同伴们的选择感到懊恼（有些人比其他人更让他头疼），但他却对他们保护得无微不至。当危险来临时，他总能迅速行动，以狂暴之势和不顾一切的勇气，率领队伍冲向塔克希斯的邪恶势力。

description.original: Flint hits anything that gets too close with his axe.
description.display: 弗林特会用斧头砍向任何靠得太近的东西。

longDescription.original: Flint attacks the nearest enemy with his trusty battleaxe.
longDescription.display: 弗林特用他那把得力战斧攻击了最近的敌人。

description.original: Flint deals one ultimate hit to a small group of nearby enemies and knocks them back.
description.display: 弗林特对附近的一小群敌人发动一次终极攻击，并将他们击退。

longDescription.original: Flint deals one ultimate hit to a small group of nearby enemies, knocking them far away and stunning them.
longDescription.display: 弗林特对附近的一小群敌人发动一次终极打击，将他们击飞至远处并使其陷入眩晕状态。
